calculation.description: Cross-sectional contrarian score to the 60-session return ending 10 sessions ago; higher scores favor assets with weaker medium-term performance, while excluding the latest 10 sessions to reduce short-term continuation overlap. Cross-sectional percentile rank is centered at zero.

validation.regime_notes: Positive contrarian IC was observed across 2020-22, 2023-24, 2025-26, and 2027 subperiods; 2027 was stronger but based on only 29 daily observations. Small 15-instrument cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
